whisper.name: Whisper
whisper.short: A specialist in arcane theory and practice
whisper.text: Solves problems with knowledge and magic, bending strange forces at the cost of their own integrity.
whisper.xpTrigger: Gain xp when you address a challenge with knowledge or arcane power.
list: What echoes in the ghost field?
What is hidden or lost here?
What are they about to do?

compel.name: Compel
compel.text: Through Attune, summon a ghost and command it; your authority lasts until it fulfills the order or the day ends.

tempest.name: Tempest
tempest.text: By pushing yourself, strike with lightning or call a storm around you.

iron-will.name: Iron Will
iron-will.text: Immune to the terror of seeing creatures; +1d to Resolve resistance rolls.

warded.name: Warded
warded.text: Special armor: resist supernatural consequences, or push yourself when using magic for free.

ghost-mind.name: Ghost Mind
ghost-mind.text: You sense the supernatural nearby; +1d when gathering information about it.

occultist.name: Occultist
occultist.text: After communing with an entity, +1d when commanding its worshippers.

ritual.name: Ritual
ritual.text: You can perform ritual magic; start knowing one ritual.

strange-methods.name: Strange Methods
strange-methods.text: +1 effect for arcane creations; start with one free arcane recipe.

fine-electroplasmic-hook.name: Fine Electroplasmic Hook
fine-electroplasmic-hook.text: A collapsible two-handed pole that catches ghosts for the bottle; load 1.

fine-spirit-mask.name: Fine Spirit Mask
fine-spirit-mask.text: Lets you see the supernatural and protects against possession.

ghost-key.name: Ghost Key
ghost-key.text: Opens ghost doors in the ghost field.

nyryx-ghost.name: Nyryx
nyryx-ghost.text: A good tipster, or a runaway subordinate.

scarlock.name: Scurlock
scarlock.text: A teacher, or a dangerous enemy.

setarra.name: Setarra
setarra.text: A partner in dark experiments, or an enemy who slipped out of control.

quellyn.name: Quellyn
quellyn.text: A healer and seer, or an apprentice who left in a scandal.

pebbles.name: Flint
pebbles.text: A source of arcane resources, or a rival in the occult world.
